scope: 99 dissertation metadata seeds:89 core SEM/CFA/growth/path/measurement records and10 adjacent IRT/latent-class/exploratory-factor/scale-structure/planned-CFA records. The planned CFA case is explicitly not counted as completed core CFA.

excluded_passages.locator: Introduction; Additional Resources, PDF viewer pp23–24
excluded_passages.reason: Tutorial supplies dyadic specifications and model-fit corrections; no additional explicit unresolved mathematical target found in the full-text screen. Pedagogical questions answered by the paper are not open conjectures.

Small-sample/model/data robustness is a historical study request. The same authors’ 2024 letter reports later simulations and rejects their earlier recommendation. Kept as dated evidence, not added as a fresh open conjecture.
Reported efficiency improvements concern the evaluated wheat data. The paper does not pose a universal dominance conjecture, so no such conjecture is invented.
Age/sex-specific genetic and environmental effects are empirical questions. Reported non-convergence is an observation, not an author-stated impossibility or convergence conjecture.
Replication, population diversity and clinical behavioral associations require observations; no purely mathematical open target recorded.

excluded_passages.locator: Challenges/recommendations; final discussion, PDF viewer pp21–22
excluded_passages.reason: Stakeholder participation, aggregation choices and practical model-building recommendations do not supply an explicit mathematical statement. No formal guarantee is inferred from the word model.
Larger/more general samples and educational intervention effects are empirical and social-science questions.
Demographic/contextual differences and modern-sample replication are empirical. The paper’s four introductory research questions are addressed in its study, not leftover mathematical conjectures.
Instrument validation, patient roles and links to healthcare outcomes are empirical. Low sample variability does not state a general identifiability theorem.

excluded_passages.locator: Section7 Future Research, PDF viewer pp12–13
excluded_passages.reason: Leadership responsibilities, teacher/principal satisfaction and multilevel empirical follow-up do not pose a mathematical guarantee; multilevel terminology alone is insufficient.

excluded_passages.locator: The Nocturnal Ecology Research Gap; Conclusion
excluded_passages.reason: Predator identification, diel ecology, sampling observations and climate responses need empirical ecological investigation; no explicit mathematical conjecture extracted.
Cross-population validation, associations and empirical measurement invariance are data-dependent. No author-stated mathematical guarantee is invented.
Developmental dimensions, sociocultural influences and temporal reliability/scale validation require observations; not mathematical conjectures.
Race/ethnicity and international-student DIF, population replication and correlations with other assessments are empirical validation questions.
Longitudinal causal ordering and multi-informant clinical assessments require new observations, not a proof of the social/clinical theory.

excluded_passages.locator: Section5.1 Limitations and future directions, lines1007–1031
excluded_passages.reason: Attitudes, social-location interactions and improved fertility-intention measurements are empirical; no mathematical open statement extracted.

screen_method: Search complete extracted texts for questions, conjectures, unknown cases and future-work language; inspect introductions, relevant definitions and closing passages; read in-paper answers and later inspected continuations. Not line-by-line proof verification.
